create_adsorbate_from_atoms: create an Adsorbate object from an ase.Atoms object with specified binding atom indices
create_adsorbate_from_smiles: create an Adsorbate object by looking up a SMILES string in the adsorbate database
create_adsorbate_from_db_id: create an Adsorbate object by selecting one from the database using its integer index
create_adsorbate_random: create an Adsorbate object by randomly sampling one from the adsorbate database
rotate_adsorbate_randomly: rotate an adsorbate using random or heuristic 3D rotation modes around its center of mass or binding atom
